method: Inspected unmodified browser PNGs with view_image, alongside zero-tolerance pixel comparison against the original source.
observations: Notification stays at the viewport origin while the right drawer is partially translated.
During the dark phone bottom-drawer exit, the notification retains its full opacity, safe-area position, diagnostic text, Copy error and Dismiss controls.
The real production route retains the error card and copy action over the existing session content and composer.
Mixed persistent error, lifecycle completion with Undo, and short notification are distinct and do not overlap; the +1 more control retains the additional pinned warning.

On the dark phone, the existing viewport-origin notification covers the confirmation title/body, exactly as in the original-source screenshot; Cancel and Save remain visible and the notification can be dismissed. This migration does not move the original notification origin.
scope: Representative visual review; exact full-image comparison is separately recorded by audit.py. No claim of real-device or screen-reader audio verification.
